welcome_subtitle: A creative sanctuary focusing on craftsmanship, cosplay, and community.
about_teaser_p1: Cosplay for alle (CfA) is a community passionate about cosplay and craftsmanship. We are a member-based organization for cosplay enthusiasts at all skill levels.
about_teaser_p2: Whether you work with sewing, prop-making, 3D printing, or EVA foam, we gather to learn, build, and create amazing costumes together!
events_section_desc: Here you will find an overview of upcoming conventions and events we plan to attend!
gallery_teaser_desc: Photos and creations from our wonderful members.
join_community_desc: We welcome all cosplayers – whether you are a beginner or an experienced maker.
about_page_subtitle: We celebrate creativity, costume design, and community.
vision_p1: Our vision is to make cosplay accessible to everyone, regardless of experience level. We learn from each other, share tools, and build fantastic creations in an inclusive environment.
vision_p2: We organize meetups, workshops, and group trips to conventions all over Norway!
